(21)༄༅/ /spyan ras gzigs dpal mo lugs kyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (21)༄༅// spyan ras gzigs dpal mo lugs kyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs so//

(22)༄༅// spyan gzigs dpal mo dpal bzang ting 'dzin bzang*// jo bo yol ston rog ston rtsis ston zhang*// gsal ston rnal 'byor skyabs ce sangs rgyas dpon// rin byang bsod grags rgyal sras rgya ma ba// lo grags byang sems kun rgyal sras pa'i rje// rje btsun grol mchog chos sku lha dbang grags// kun snying phrin las rin chen rgya mtsho dpal// mtha' yas kun bzang tshe dbang nor bu'i sde// ngag dbang rnam rgyal kun bzang mthu stobs zhabs// nyi ma chos 'phel blo gsal bstan skyong dang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// skyabs su 'gro dang byang chub sems bskyed nas// skye med a las 'gags med lha yi sku// snang stong zung 'jug spros bral rnal 'byor gyis// spyan ras gzigs dbang 'grub par byin gyi rlobs/ /zhes pa'ang mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa sid+dhi ri stu/ ༈ /thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid dpal mo lugs kyi nyams len snying por dril ba zung 'jug myur lam bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhi/ 'phags mchog snying rje'i zla ba ni// dad brgya'i gtsug gis rtag mchod (23)nas// gang de'i rnal 'byor grub pa'i phul// dpal mo'i bzhed gzhung snying po 'bri// 'di la gnyis/ thun dngos la ji ltar bya ba'i tshul dang*/ thun mtshams su ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo// dang po la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul gsal btab ste/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs sogs skyabs sems dang*/ spro na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi/ sogs yan lag bdun pa dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ dngos gzhi la gnyis/ bskyed rim dang*/ rdzogs rim mo// dang po ni/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i snying gar a dkar po 'od zer 'bar ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim gzung bya'i yul dang bral ba'i rang rig pa'i ngo bo pad zla'i gdan la sa bon hrīḥdakar po las pad+ma hrīḥs mtshan pa// de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid skad cig gis 'phags pa thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/

phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas mu tig dkar (24)po'i phreng ba dang*/ g.yon 'og mas gser gyi pad+ma yu ba dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing*/ ri dwags kriṣ+ṇā sā ri'i pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba la hrīḥdakar pos mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ spyi bor rigs kyi bdag po bla ma 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la ltar snang sgyu ma lta bu la sems bzung*/ des skyon bzlas pa bya ba ni/ thugs ka'i hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba las/ thugs rje chen po'i sku dang 'od zer gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ ces dmigs la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes ci nus bzla/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba la shas mi bzod pa'i snying rje chen po drag tu bskyed cing*/ skabs su nga'i ma zhes ngag tu'ang brjod la snying rje'i rtsal sbyang ngo*// gnyis pa rdzogs rim ni/ de'i ngang du blo lhod kyis glod la/ skye 'gags gnas gsum gyi spros pa dang bral ba'i gnas lugs ma bcos pa'i dbyings su mnyam par bzhag /gsum pa rjes ni/ thun las ldang ba na/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces sogs bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar te spyod lam la 'jug /gnyis pa thun mtshams su ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/

zas za ba/ gos gon pa/ stan la 'dug pa/ nyal ba ldang ba sogs kyi gnas skabs thams cad du byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang ma bral ba la bslab/ tshe 'dir 'bras bu mngon du ma gyur na/ 'chi khar 'tshang rgya ba 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ snod bcud thams cad 'od (25)du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang rig pa'i ngo bo a dkar po la thim/ ngag tu a a zhes brjod pa'i mthar a de'ang nam mkha'i 'ja' yal ba ltar bsams la dbyings rig bsre 'pho ba ma theb bar do 'char na/ snang grags rtog gsum 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i gsang ba gsum gyi ngo bor shes par byas la mnyam par bzhag pas lam gyi 'phro mthud de grol ba thob bar 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o// 'jam dbyangs la sogs phyogs bcu yi// sras bcas rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse'i dngos// 'phags mchog snying rje'i gter chen gyi// rnal 'byor zab mo 'jug bde'i phul// thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid dpal mo lugs kyi nyams len snying por dril ba'i le'u tshan no/// /(26)
